result.stdout:
Description:
  Read database metadata and export a versioned schema document. Does not change the database.

Usage:
  DubUrl.Cli schema inspect [options]

Options:
  --password-prompt                                  Explicitly read a hidden password from the terminal.
  --credential <credential>                          Read a named credential saved with 'duburl credential add'.
  --username <username>                              Username for the selected external credential source.
  --os-identity                                      Use the current process identity or existing ticket cache through the selected driver.
  --oauth <oauth>                                    Explicit OAuth sign-in: browser or device-code (Entra only).
  --oauth-client-id <oauth-client-id>                Registered public-client application ID; never a client secret.
  --oauth-tenant <oauth-tenant>                      Entra tenant ID; exclusive with --oauth-authority.
  --oauth-authority <oauth-authority>                Trusted HTTPS tenant authority (or exact Snowflake account authority).
  --oauth-scope <oauth-scope>                        OAuth scope; repeat for each scope.
  --oauth-redirect-uri <oauth-redirect-uri>          Registered loopback HTTP redirect for browser sign-in.
  --oauth-login-hint <oauth-login-hint>              Optional account hint; does not change the process identity.
  --oauth-account <oauth-account>                    Trusted Snowflake account identifier; defaults to the target host.
  --oauth-timeout <oauth-timeout>                    Sign-in budget in seconds (1-3600, default 120), separate from --timeout.
  --allow-oauth-interaction                          Deliberately allow sign-in and stderr device instructions with redirected input/output. Never implied by --yes.
  --client-certificate <client-certificate>          Client certificate: PEM with --client-key, or a PFX/P12 bundle.
  --client-key <client-key>                          Matching PEM private-key file.
  --certificate-password-prompt    
[truncated]

Description:
  Prepare a catalog from top-level archives without uploading, installing, or loading provider code.

Usage:
  DubUrl.Cli catalog create <folder> [options]

Arguments:
  <folder>  Folder of provider-pack ZIPs. Subfolders and unrelated files are ignored.

Options:
  --output <output> (REQUIRED)                      New directory for catalog artifacts and copied archives.
  --archive-base-uri <archive-base-uri> (REQUIRED)  Clean HTTPS location where the copied archives will be hosted.
  --trust-mode <trust-mode>                         sha256 (default), unsigned, or signed.
  --source-id <source-id>                           Stable catalog source ID (default enterprise).
  --catalog-uri <catalog-uri>                       Published catalog HTTPS or file URI. Defaults to the generated local catalog.
  --signing-key <signing-key>                       Encrypted PKCS#8 private PEM path, or '-' for redirected stdin; signed mode only.
  --expires-at <expires-at>                         ISO 8601 expiry or 'none' (default: no expiration).
  --publisher-state <publisher-state>               Persistent publisher revision directory. Defaults to DubUrl/catalog-publication-revisions in local application data.
  --signing-password-env <signing-password-env>     Password environment variable (default DUBURL_CATALOG_SIGNING_PASSWORD). Never pass the password itself.
  --json                                            Write stable result metadata with relative artifact references.
  -?, -h, --help                                    Show help and usage information
